build_command: npm run build (DO NOT RUN - user runs on their own cadence)
test_command: npm run test (DO NOT RUN routinely - user rule forbids it)
verification_instructions: Per explicit user/steering rules: DO NOT run npm run build, npm run typecheck, npm run lint, or npm run test as routine verification. DO NOT start npm run dev (it blocks). Rely on editor diagnostics for type correctness. These are presentational TSX edits. The e2e probes tests/e2e/specs/skeleton-fidelity.spec.ts (visual, writes PNGs, only hard-asserts finalBoxes.length>0) and tests/e2e/specs/layout-shift.spec.ts (CLS) are run by the user, not here; neither asserts specific skeleton bar widths, so the uniform-texture change does not break them as long as reserved geometry is preserved.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None relevant. skeleton-fidelity.spec.ts writes PNGs under ux-review/ at runtime but that is a manual probe, not a checked-in snapshot.
setup_instructions: Dependencies are already installed (existing project). No setup needed.
environment_constraints: Autopilot/Supervised - apply edits directly to files, no patch file. No build/test/lint/dev commands from agent turns.
contribution_requirements: Components are PascalCase.tsx, 2-space indent, single quotes + semicolons in domain/lib. Lead non-trivial modules with a header comment; MANY skeleton files already have detailed header + inline comments explaining which heights/insets/widths are load-bearing and why. PRESERVE that reasoning - update comments to match the new approach rather than deleting the explanations. Use cn() from @/lib/utils. Hugeicons not lucide (not relevant to skeletons).
key_patterns: Skeleton system: components/ui/skeleton.tsx exports Skeleton (div: 'animate-skeleton rounded-md bg-muted/70') and TextLines (bars sized to the surrounding type scale via h-[0.9em]). animate-skeleton keyframes live in app/globals.css (250ms delayed reveal + shallow pulse to opacity 0.6) - DO NOT change the animation. Loaders reserve FIXED GEOMETRY and must never shift content on data arrival (hard rule in .kiro/steering/structure.md). Shared primitives: components/layout/WorkspaceSkeletons.tsx, catalogSkeletons.tsx, MarketplaceShellSkeleton.tsx. Named *Skeleton.tsx components in components/{auth,contract,deals,listings,onboarding,payments,layout}. Route loading.tsx files under app/.
directory_structure: Skeleton primitives in components/ui/. Shared page-shaped placeholders in components/layout/. Per-feature named *Skeleton.tsx in components/<feature>/. Route-segment loading.tsx under app/(workspace)/**, app/(marketing)/**, app/onboarding/. Route groups like (home)/(inbox)/(list)/(detail)/(console)/(queue) exist to keep loaders in leaf positions - do not move loaders between segments.
